name: CommuteAssistCongestionCharge

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short driving scene. A driver asks their assistant whether their planned route passes through a congestion charge or low emission zone. One question, one answer.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City driving, urban roads, approaching city centre, traffic

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short driving scene. The driver is heading toward the city centre and asks Sigma whether their route goes through a congestion charge or ULEZ zone. Sigma gives a yes or no with the key detail. Driver reacts briefly.

user1.name: Tobias
user1.tts_prompt: Measured, approaching city, slightly wary of charges

variations.context: Checking for congestion charge zone on the route into the city

setting.mood: Pragmatic, wants to know before committing to the route
setting.relationship_dynamic: Suburban commuter driving into the city
setting.background: He doesn't drive into the city centre often. Wants to know if he'll be charged before he commits to this approach.
setting.conversation_style: One practical question. One yes/no answer with a boundary detail.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks Sigma if their route goes through a congestion or ULEZ zone
scenario_template.mood: Practical, checking before it's too late to turn
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, does this route go through the congestion zone?' or 'Sigma, am I entering ULEZ here?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma confirms yes or no with the zone boundary. Driver reacts.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: yes/no + where the zone starts. One sentence. Driver: 'right' or adjusts.

user1.name: Tobias
user1.role: Suburban driver heading into the city. Wants to know about charges before entering. Brief and direct.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Confirms zone status and boundary in one sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Driver needs a yes or no before committing to the road.
Sigma gives zone status and where the boundary is. One sentence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Yes or no plus zone boundary. One sentence.
